banner.title: prometheus-operator-crds
banner.tagline: Installs the monitoring.coreos.com CRDs that every ServiceMonitor, PodMonitor and PrometheusRule in the cluster is written against.

steps.title: Fetch
steps.text: Flux pulls the prometheus-operator-crds OCI chart at the tag pinned in ocirepository.yaml, every ten minutes.
steps.scene: a sealed crate arriving from a registry

steps.title: Apply
steps.text: The HelmRelease installs the CRDs with no values set, so the chart's defaults are the whole configuration.
steps.scene: a blueprint sheet pinned to a board

steps.title: Use
steps.text: The operator in kube-prometheus-stack reconciles Prometheus from these definitions. Monitors and rules in every namespace depend on them.
steps.scene: monitor and rule cards plugged into one hub
